uk.R: Для того, хто керує співом. На лад «Ґіттіт». Від Асафа.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: the gittith: an instrument or tune, perhaps from Gath
decisions.reason: The word (gittit) is found in the titles of Psalms 8, 81 and 84. It may be an instrument or tune from the city of Gath, or be linked with the word for a winepress (gat). Its sense is no longer known.

decisions.choice: Asaph: a leader of the temple singers
decisions.reason: Asaph was a Levite whom David appointed to lead the singing before the ark (1 Chronicles 16:5-7); his family carried on the work. Psalms 50 and 73-83 bear his name. "Of Asaph" may mean the psalm belongs to his family's collection.

decisions.choice: "la guittith" kept as a name at every level, written with French spelling
decisions.reason: No one knows whether the gittith was an instrument or a tune, perhaps one from Gath (meaning decision m3), so French keeps the word, as the English does; Readable sets it in quotation marks as a name.

decisions.choice: "gitithi" kept as a name at every level, as the English keeps "gittith"
decisions.reason: The word may name an instrument or a tune, perhaps from Gath; its meaning is not known, so it stays a name, as the terms note says for the musical words whose meaning is lost.

decisions.choice: sobre la guitit (L, B); Con «la guitit» (R)
decisions.reason: Gittith is a musical term whose meaning is lost: perhaps an instrument or a tune from the town of Gath, perhaps a song for the wine press. Spanish keeps the word in a Spanish spelling at every level, as the English keeps "gittith", without guessing.

decisions.choice: "Ghi-tít", kept as a name
decisions.reason: The word may name an instrument or a tune, perhaps from Gath (see the meaning decision); since that is not certain, every level keeps it as a name, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "깃딧" kept as a name at every level
decisions.reason: Its meaning is lost: an instrument or a tune, perhaps from Gath (meaning decision). The English keeps the word at every level, and so does Korean, in its established Protestant form.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 81.
alternatives: spans like the English ones (from verse 6)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: on the gittith as "በጊቲት", as the terms list's heading table; Readable «ጊቲት» በሚባለው ዜማ with its English
decisions.reason: What the word names is not known (meaning decision m3), so it stays a name at every level.

decisions.choice: गित्तीत, kept as a name
decisions.reason: Gittith may be an instrument or a tune, perhaps from Gath (m3); its meaning is not known, so every level keeps the word as the English does, in the form the poetry note gives.

decisions.choice: "на гиттите", kept as a name
decisions.reason: As the poetry note settles, terms whose meaning is lost stay names where the English keeps them. Gittith may be an instrument or a tune from Gath (the meaning decision); "гиттит" keeps the word without choosing.

en.L: Sing for joy to God our strength; \q shout to the God of Jacob.
en.B: Sing out with joy to God, our strength; \q raise a shout to the God of Jacob!
en.R: Sing with joy to God, who gives us strength! \q Shout to the God of Jacob's people!

fr.L: Criez de joie pour Dieu, notre force ; \q acclamez le Dieu de Jacob.
fr.B: Chantez avec joie pour Dieu, notre force ; \q poussez des acclamations pour le Dieu de Jacob !
fr.R: Chantez de joie pour Dieu, qui nous donne la force ! \q Acclamez le Dieu du peuple de Jacob !

sw.L: Mwimbieni kwa furaha Mungu nguvu yetu; \q mpigieni kelele Mungu wa Yakobo.
sw.B: Mwimbieni Mungu kwa furaha, aliye nguvu yetu; \q mpigieni Mungu wa Yakobo kelele za shangwe!
sw.R: Mwimbieni kwa furaha Mungu anayetupa nguvu! \q Mpigieni kelele Mungu wa watu wa Yakobo!

es.L: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} con júbilo a Dios, nuestra fortaleza; \q {{plural_you:aclamen|aclamad}} al Dios de Jacob.
es.B: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} con alegría a Dios, nuestra fuerza; \q ¡{{plural_you:lancen|lanzad}} gritos de júbilo al Dios de Jacob!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} con alegría a Dios, que nos da fuerzas! \q ¡{{plural_you:Griten|Gritad}} de júbilo al Dios del pueblo de Jacob!

vi.L: Hãy reo vui cho Đức Chúa Trời là sức mạnh của chúng ta; \q hãy tung hô Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp.

ko.L: 우리의 힘이신 하나님께 기뻐 노래하여라. \q 야곱의 하나님께 환호하여라.
ko.B: 우리의 힘이신 하나님께 기쁨으로 노래하여라. \q 야곱의 하나님께 소리 높여 환호하여라!
ko.R: 우리에게 힘을 주시는 하나님께 기쁘게 노래하여라! \q 야곱 자손의 하나님께 큰 소리로 외쳐라!

pt.L: Cantem com alegria a Deus, nossa força; \q aclamem o Deus de Jacó.
pt.B: Cantem alegres a Deus, a nossa força; \q levantem um brado ao Deus de Jacó!
pt.R: Cantem com alegria a Deus, que nos dá força! \q Gritem de alegria ao Deus do povo de Jacó!

am.L: ብርታታችን ለሆነው ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ፤ \q ለያዕቆብ አምላክ ጩኹ።
am.B: ብርታታችን ለሆነው ለእግዚአብሔር በደስታ ዘምሩ፤ \q ለያዕቆብ አምላክ የደስታ ጩኸት አሰሙ!
am.R: ብርታት ለሚሰጠን ለእግዚአብሔር በደስታ ዘምሩ! \q ለያዕቆብ ዘሮች አምላክ እልል በሉ!

hi.L: हमारे बल परमेश्वर के लिए आनंद से गाओ; \q याकूब के परमेश्वर के लिए जयजयकार करो।
hi.B: परमेश्वर के लिए, जो हमारा बल हैं, आनंद से गीत गाओ; \q याकूब के परमेश्वर के लिए जयजयकार करो!
hi.R: आनंद से परमेश्वर के लिए गाओ, जो हमें बल देते हैं! \q याकूब के लोगों के परमेश्वर के लिए ऊँचे स्वर से जयजयकार करो!

ru.L: Пойте с радостью Богу, нашей силе; \q восклицайте Богу Иакова.
ru.B: Пойте радостно Богу, нашей силе; \q громко восклицайте Богу Иакова!
ru.R: Радостно пойте Богу, который даёт нам силу! \q Восклицайте Богу народа Иакова!

uk.L: Радісно співайте Богові, нашій силі; \q викликуйте Богові Якова.
uk.B: Співайте з радістю Богові, нашій силі; \q здійміть радісний крик Богові Якова!
uk.R: Співайте радісно Богові, який дає нам силу! \q Вигукуйте Богові народу Якова!

decisions.choice: a festival song
decisions.reason: The psalm calls the people to a feast (verse 4) and then gives God's own words to them (verses 7-17), as a priest or prophet might speak them at the festival.

decisions.choice: shout: a loud cry of acclaim
decisions.reason: The verb (rua') is the shout raised for a king or in battle (47:2; 66:1).

decisions.choice: Jacob's people
decisions.reason: Readable says that Jacob stands for the people of Israel (79:7).

decisions.choice: The singer calls the festival crowd in 해라체 (verses 2-6); God's own words (verses 7-17) are in 해라체 with "나", addressing Israel as "너"
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a and the terms note: God speaking uses 해라체 with 나. A call to a gathered people to sing is in the plain imperative, as the terms note renders "Praise Yah" with "찬양하여라".

decisions.choice: तुम (गाओ, करो) to the worshippers; honorific वे for God
decisions.reason: The psalmist calls the people to worship with the plural imperative, as he speaks to people everywhere in these psalms; God spoken of takes the honorific plural (जो हमारा बल हैं), as in the history books.

records.literal_gloss: Lift up a song and give [the] tambourine, [the] pleasant lyre with [the] harp.

en.L: Lift up a song and sound [the] tambourine, \q the pleasant lyre with the harp.
en.B: Strike up the music and beat the tambourine; \q play the sweet lyre along with the harp.
en.R: Start the music! Play the tambourine. \q Play lovely music on the lyre and the harp.

fr.L: Élevez un chant et faites résonner [le] tambourin, \q la lyre agréable avec la harpe.
fr.B: Lancez la musique et frappez le tambourin ; \q jouez de la douce lyre avec la harpe.
fr.R: Commencez la musique ! Jouez du tambourin. \q Jouez de belles mélodies sur la lyre et sur la harpe.

sw.L: Inueni wimbo na kupiga matari, \q kinubi kizuri pamoja na zeze.
sw.B: Anzisheni muziki na kupiga matari; \q pigeni kinubi kitamu pamoja na zeze.
sw.R: Anzeni muziki! Pigeni matari. \q Pigeni muziki mzuri kwa kinubi na zeze.

es.L: {{plural_you:Entonen|Entonad}} un canto y {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} [el] pandero, \q la lira agradable con el arpa.
es.B: {{plural_you:Comiencen|Comenzad}} la música y {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} el pandero; \q {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} la dulce lira junto con el arpa.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Empiecen|Empezad}} la música! {{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} el pandero. \q {{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} música hermosa con la lira y el arpa.

vi.L: Hãy cất tiếng hát và đánh trống cơm, \q [gảy] đàn lia êm dịu cùng đàn hạc.
vi.B: Hãy trổi nhạc lên và đánh trống cơm; \q hãy gảy đàn lia êm dịu cùng đàn hạc.
vi.R: Hãy bắt đầu cuộc hòa nhạc! Hãy đánh trống cơm. \q Hãy chơi những điệu nhạc hay trên đàn lia và đàn hạc.

ko.L: 노래를 높이고 소고를 울려라. \q 수금과 하프를 아름답게 [타라].
ko.B: 노래를 시작하고 소고를 쳐라. \q 아름다운 수금과 하프를 함께 타라.
ko.R: 음악을 시작하여라! 소고를 쳐라. \q 수금과 하프로 아름다운 음악을 연주하여라.

pt.L: Levantem um cântico e toquem [o] tamborim, \q a lira agradável com a harpa.
pt.B: Comecem a música e batam o tamborim; \q toquem a lira suave junto com a harpa.
pt.R: Comecem a música! Toquem o tamborim. \q Toquem músicas bonitas na lira e na harpa.

am.L: ዝማሬን አንሡ፤ ከበሮንም ስጡ፤ \q ጣፋጩን በገና ከመሰንቆ ጋር።
am.B: ዜማውን ጀምሩ፤ ከበሮውንም ምቱ፤ \q ጣፋጩን በገና ከመሰንቆ ጋር ተጫወቱ።
am.R: ሙዚቃውን ጀምሩ! ከበሮ ምቱ። \q በበገናና በመሰንቆ ደስ የሚል ዜማ ተጫወቱ።

hi.L: गीत उठाओ और डफ़ बजाओ, \q सारंगी के साथ मधुर वीणा भी।
hi.B: संगीत आरंभ करो और डफ़ बजाओ; \q सारंगी के साथ मधुर वीणा बजाओ।
hi.R: संगीत शुरू करो! डफ़ बजाओ। \q वीणा और सारंगी पर मधुर संगीत बजाओ।

ru.L: Поднимите песнь и ударьте в бубен, \q [возьмите] приятную лиру с арфой.
ru.B: Начинайте музыку и бейте в бубен; \q играйте на сладкозвучной лире вместе с арфой.
ru.R: Начинайте музыку! Играйте на бубне. \q Играйте красивую музыку на лире и арфе.

uk.L: Підійміть пісню й ударте в бубон, \q [візьміть] приємну ліру з арфою.
uk.B: Заграйте музику й ударте в бубон; \q грайте на милозвучній лірі разом з арфою.
uk.R: Починайте музику! Грайте на бубні. \q Грайте гарну музику на лірі й арфі.

decisions.choice: tambourine, lyre and harp
decisions.reason: As in 33:2: the tof was a hand drum, the kinnor a light lyre held in the hands, the nevel a larger harp. All three were played at times of celebration (Exodus 15:20; 2 Samuel 6:5).

decisions.choice: lift up a song: begin the music
decisions.reason: To lift up a song is to raise the voice or begin to play (98:5).

decisions.choice: tambourine (tof) as "ከበሮ", lyre (kinnor) as "በገና", harp (nevel) as "መሰንቆ", as 1 Samuel 10:5 and 2 Samuel 6:5
decisions.reason: The instrument words already settled in Samuel on main.

decisions.choice: वीणा (kinnor, lyre); सारंगी (nevel, harp); डफ़ (tambourine)
decisions.reason: The instruments keep the words of Genesis 31:27, 1 Samuel 10:5 and 2 Samuel 6:5 in this translation: the lyre (kinnor) is वीणा, the harp (nevel) सारंगी, the tambourine डफ़. The exact shape of either stringed instrument is not known (m1).

source.text: תִּקְע֣וּ בַחֹ֣דֶשׁ שׁוֹפָ֑ר בַּ֝כֵּ֗סֶה לְי֣וֹם חַגֵּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Blow at [the] new moon [the] ram's horn, at [the] full moon, on [the] day of our feast,

en.L: Blow the ram's horn at the new moon, \q at the full moon, on the day of our feast,
en.B: At the new moon, blow the ram's horn, \q and at the full moon, for our feast day,
en.R: When the new moon appears, blow the ram's horn. \q Blow it again when the moon is full, on our feast day.

fr.L: Sonnez de la corne de bélier à la nouvelle lune, \q à la pleine lune, au jour de notre fête,
fr.B: À la nouvelle lune, sonnez de la corne de bélier, \q et à la pleine lune, pour notre jour de fête,
fr.R: Quand paraît la nouvelle lune, sonnez de la corne de bélier. \q Sonnez encore quand la lune est pleine, le jour de notre fête.

sw.L: Pigeni baragumu wakati wa mwezi mpya, \q wakati wa mwezi mpevu, siku ya sikukuu yetu,
sw.B: Wakati wa mwezi mpya, pigeni baragumu, \q na wakati wa mwezi mpevu, kwa siku ya sikukuu yetu,
sw.R: Mwezi mpya unapoonekana, pigeni baragumu. \q Ipigeni tena mwezi unapokuwa mpevu, siku ya sikukuu yetu.

es.L: {{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} el cuerno de carnero en la luna nueva, \q en la luna llena, en el día de nuestra fiesta,
es.B: En la luna nueva, {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} el cuerno de carnero, \q y en la luna llena, para nuestro día de fiesta,
es.R: Cuando aparezca la luna nueva, {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} el cuerno de carnero. \q {{plural_you:Tóquenlo|Tocadlo}} otra vez cuando la luna esté llena, en nuestro día de fiesta.

vi.L: Hãy thổi kèn sừng dê đực vào ngày trăng mới, \q vào ngày trăng rằm, trong ngày lễ của chúng ta,
vi.B: Vào ngày trăng mới, hãy thổi kèn sừng dê đực, \q và vào ngày trăng rằm, cho ngày lễ của chúng ta,
vi.R: Khi trăng non xuất hiện, hãy thổi kèn sừng dê đực. \q Hãy thổi lần nữa khi trăng tròn, vào ngày lễ của chúng ta.

ko.L: 초하루에 숫양의 뿔나팔을 불어라. \q 보름에, 우리 명절날에.
ko.B: 초하루에 숫양의 뿔나팔을 불고, \q 보름달이 뜨는 우리 명절날에도 불어라.
ko.R: 초승달이 뜨면 숫양의 뿔나팔을 불어라. \q 달이 둥글게 차는 우리 명절날에 다시 불어라.

pt.L: Toquem o chifre de carneiro na lua nova, \q na lua cheia, no dia da nossa festa,
pt.B: Na lua nova, toquem o chifre de carneiro, \q e na lua cheia, para o dia da nossa festa,
pt.R: Quando aparecer a lua nova, toquem o chifre de carneiro. \q Toquem de novo quando a lua estiver cheia, no dia da nossa festa.

decisions.choice: new moon and full moon: the autumn festival
alternatives: any new moon and full-moon festival
decisions.reason: The month began at the new moon, and the great feasts fell at the full moon, in the middle of the month. In the seventh month the horn was blown on the first day (Leviticus 23:24), and the Feast of Shelters began at the full moon on the fifteenth (Leviticus 23:34). The psalm is probably for that season.

decisions.choice: the ram's horn: the shofar

decisions.choice: "бараний рог" for the shofar

decisions.choice: a testimony: a solemn charge
decisions.reason: The word ('edut) is the covenant law as God's witness to his people (19:8; 78:5).

decisions.choice: he went out: God going out against Egypt
alternatives: when Joseph went out over the land of Egypt
decisions.reason: "He" is most likely God, who "went out" through Egypt on the night of the Passover (Exodus 11:4). It can also be read of Joseph, who went out over the land of Egypt as its ruler (Genesis 41:45).

decisions.choice: a language I did not know: the voice of God's message
alternatives: Israel heard a language it did not know (in Egypt)
decisions.reason: The speaker hears a voice he does not recognize, and verses 7-17 give what it says: God's own words. Others take the line of Israel in Egypt hearing a foreign tongue (114:1).

decisions.choice: Joseph: the people of Israel
decisions.reason: Joseph stands for the whole people, as in 77:16 and 80:2.

decisions.choice: a voice
decisions.reason: The word (safah, "lip") is speech or language; here it is the voice the speaker hears (m3).

decisions.choice: God; It said
decisions.reason: Readable names who set the rule and marks that the words that follow are spoken.

vi.L: "Ta đã cất gánh nặng khỏi vai nó; \q tay nó đã được buông khỏi giỏ.
vi.B: "Ta đã cất gánh nặng khỏi vai họ; \q tay họ đã buông khỏi giỏ gạch.
vi.R: "Ta đã cất những gánh nặng khỏi vai dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ta đã giải thoát tay họ khỏi việc khiêng những giỏ gạch.

ko.L: "내가 그의 어깨에서 짐을 벗겼고, \q 그의 손이 광주리에서 놓여났다.
ko.B: "내가 그들의 어깨에서 무거운 짐을 내려 주었고, \q 그들의 손에서 벽돌 광주리를 놓게 했다.
ko.R: "내가 내 백성의 어깨에서 무거운 짐을 내려 주었다. \q 그들이 벽돌 광주리를 나르지 않게 그 손을 풀어 주었다.

pt.L: "Removi do fardo o seu ombro; \q as suas mãos foram livradas do cesto.
pt.B: "Tirei dos ombros deles a carga pesada; \q as mãos deles largaram o cesto de tijolos.
pt.R: "Tirei as cargas pesadas dos ombros do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo. \q Libertei as mãos deles de carregar cestos de tijolos.

am.B: «ከባዱን ሸክም ከትከሻቸው አነሣሁ፤ \q እጆቻቸውም የጡብ ቅርጫቱን ለቀቁ።
am.R: «ከሕዝቤ ትከሻ ላይ ከባዱን ሸክም አወረድኩ። \q እጆቻቸውንም የጡብ ቅርጫት ከመሸከም ነጻ አወጣሁ።

hi.L: "मैंने उसके कंधे को बोझ से हटाया; \q उसके हाथ टोकरी से छूट गए।
hi.B: "मैंने उनके कंधों से भारी बोझ उतार दिया; \q उनके हाथों से ईंटों की टोकरी छूट गई।
hi.R: "मैंने अपने लोगों के कंधों से भारी बोझ उतार दिए। \q मैंने उनके हाथों को ईंटों की टोकरियाँ ढोने से छुड़ा दिया।

ru.L: «Я снял с его плеча бремя; \q его руки освободились от корзины.
ru.B: «Я снял тяжёлую ношу с их плеч; \q их руки выпустили корзину для кирпичей.
ru.R: «Я снял тяжёлые грузы с плеч {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} народа. \q Я освободил их руки, чтобы им больше не таскать корзины с кирпичами.

uk.L: «Я зняв з його плеча тягар; \q його руки звільнилися від коша.
uk.B: «Я зняв важкий тягар з їхніх плечей; \q їхні руки випустили кошик для цегли.
uk.R: «Я зняв важкі вантажі з плечей {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} народу. \q Я звільнив їхні руки від кошиків із цеглою.

decisions.choice: God's words, to verse 17
decisions.reason: From here to the end of the psalm God speaks to his people; the quotation stays open until then. "His" in this verse is Israel.

decisions.choice: burden and basket: forced labor in Egypt
decisions.reason: The burden (sevel) is the word for Israel's forced labor (Exodus 1:11; 6:6). Baskets were used to carry clay and bricks (Exodus 1:14).

decisions.choice: their
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew, Israel is "he". Balanced and Readable say "they"; Literal keeps the singular.

decisions.choice: my people; baskets of bricks
decisions.reason: Readable says whose shoulders are meant and what the baskets carried (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: God speaking: "je" with no span, and the deity_pronoun setting on "mon", "ma", "mes", "moi", "me", "m'" where the English has it on "my" and "me"
alternatives: no setting on God's first-person pronouns
decisions.reason: From here to verse 17 God speaks (meaning decision m1). French follows the English spans and the French guide's forms for a divine speaker; "je" never takes the setting.

decisions.choice: God speaks in verses 7-17 with "mimi" and the first-person verb forms, and the deity_pronoun setting is used on "wangu" (my) where the English has it
alternatives: no setting spans in God's speech
decisions.reason: The terms note has God speak as "mimi". The English spans God's "my" and "me" here, and Swahili follows on the free possessive "wangu"; the "I" inside the verb cannot take a capital.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" and calls Israel "con" (you)
decisions.reason: From here to verse 17 God speaks to Israel (see the meaning decision). He says "Ta", as the style guide sets for God speaking, and calls his people "con", as a father speaks to a child; "ngươi" is archaic and cold, and the Hebrew "you" is singular.

source.text: בַּצָּרָ֥ה קָרָ֗אתָ וָאֲחַ֫לְּצֶ֥ךָּ אֶ֭עֶנְךָ בְּסֵ֣תֶר רַ֑עַם אֶבְחָֽנְךָ֨ עַל־מֵ֖י מְרִיבָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: In trouble you called, and I rescued you; I answered you in [the] hiding place of thunder; I tested you at [the] waters of Meribah. Selah.

en.L: In trouble you called, and I rescued you; \q I answered you in the hiding place of thunder; \q I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
en.B: When you were in trouble you cried out, and I set you free; \q I answered you from the hidden place of the thunder; \q I put you to the test at the waters of Meribah. Selah
en.R: When you were in trouble, you called to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I saved you. \q I answered you from the thundercloud where I was hidden. \q I tested you at the springs of Meribah. Selah

fr.L: Dans la détresse tu as appelé, et je t’ai délivré ; \q je t’ai répondu dans la cachette du tonnerre ; \q je t’ai éprouvé aux eaux de Meriba. Sélah
fr.B: Quand tu étais dans la détresse, tu as crié, et je t’ai libéré ; \q je t’ai répondu du lieu caché du tonnerre ; \q je t’ai mis à l’épreuve aux eaux de Meriba. Sélah
fr.R: Quand tu étais dans le malheur, tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as appelé, et je t’ai sauvé. \q Je t’ai répondu du nuage d’orage où j’étais caché. \q Je t’ai mis à l’épreuve aux sources de Meriba. Sélah

sw.L: Katika taabu uliita, nami nikakuokoa; \q nilikujibu katika mahali pa siri pa radi; \q nilikujaribu penye maji ya Meriba. Sela
sw.B: Ulipokuwa katika taabu ulilia, nami nikakuweka huru; \q nilikujibu kutoka mahali pa siri pa radi; \q nilikujaribu penye maji ya Meriba. Sela
sw.R: Ulipokuwa katika taabu, uliniita, nami nikakuokoa. \q Nilikujibu kutoka katika wingu la radi nilimojificha. \q Nilikujaribu kwenye chemchemi za Meriba. Sela

es.L: En la angustia clamaste, y yo te libré; \q te respondí desde el escondite del trueno; \q te probé junto a las aguas de Meribá. Selah
es.B: Cuando estabas en apuros, clamaste, y yo te liberé; \q te respondí desde el lugar escondido del trueno; \q te puse a prueba junto a las aguas de Meribá. Selah
es.R: Cuando estabas en problemas, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamaste, y yo te salvé. \q Te respondí desde la nube de tormenta donde yo estaba escondido. \q Te puse a prueba junto a los manantiales de Meribá. Selah

vi.L: Trong cơn gian truân con đã kêu cầu, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giải cứu con; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đáp lời con trong nơi ẩn giấu của sấm sét; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thử con tại dòng nước Mê-ri-ba. Sê-la
vi.B: Khi con gặp hoạn nạn và kêu cầu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giải thoát con; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đáp lời con từ nơi kín giấu của tiếng sấm; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thử thách con tại dòng nước Mê-ri-ba. Sê-la
vi.R: Khi con gặp hoạn nạn, con kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cứu con. \q Ta đã trả lời con từ đám mây sấm sét nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ẩn mình. \q Ta đã thử con tại các dòng suối Mê-ri-ba. Sê-la

ko.L: 네가 고난 중에 부르짖으니 내가 너를 건져 주었다. \q 천둥의 숨은 곳에서 내가 너에게 응답하였다. \q 므리바 물가에서 내가 너를 시험하였다. 셀라
ko.B: 네가 고난 가운데 부르짖을 때 내가 너를 건져 주었고, \q 천둥이 숨은 곳에서 너에게 대답했으며, \q 므리바 물가에서 너를 시험했다. 셀라
ko.R: 네가 어려움을 당하여 나를 부를 때 내가 너를 구해 주었다. \q 내가 숨어 있던 천둥 구름 속에서 너에게 대답했다. \q 므리바 샘에서 내가 너를 시험했다. 셀라

pt.L: Na angústia chamaste, e eu te livrei; \q respondi-te no esconderijo do trovão; \q provei-te junto às águas de Meribá. Selá
pt.B: Quando estavas em apuros, clamaste, e eu te libertei; \q respondi-te do lugar escondido do trovão; \q pus-te à prova junto às águas de Meribá. Selá
pt.R: Quando estavas em apuros, tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} chamaste, e eu te salvei. \q Respondi-te da nuvem de trovão onde eu estava escondido. \q Eu te pus à prova junto às fontes de Meribá. Selá

am.L: በመከራ ጠራህ፤ እኔም አዳንኩህ፤ \q በነጎድጓድ መሰወሪያ ውስጥ መለስኩልህ፤ \q በመሪባ ውኆች ፈተንኩህ። ሴላ
am.B: በመከራ ሳለህ ጮኽክ፤ እኔም ነጻ አወጣሁህ፤ \q ከነጎድጓዱ ስውር ስፍራ መለስኩልህ፤ \q በመሪባ ውኆች ፈተንኩህ። ሴላ
am.R: በተቸገርክ ጊዜ ወደ እኔ ጠራህ፤ እኔም አዳንኩህ። \q ተሰውሬ ከነበርኩበት ከነጎድጓዱ ደመና መለስኩልህ። \q በመሪባ ምንጮች ፈተንኩህ። ሴላ

hi.L: संकट में तुमने पुकारा, और मैंने तुम्हें छुड़ाया; \q मैंने तुम्हें गर्जन के छिपने के स्थान में से उत्तर दिया; \q मैंने मरीबा के जल के पास तुम्हें परखा। सेला
hi.B: जब तुम संकट में थे, तब तुमने दोहाई दी, और मैंने तुम्हें छुड़ाया; \q मैंने गर्जन के छिपे हुए स्थान से तुम्हें उत्तर दिया; \q मैंने मरीबा के जल के पास तुम्हारी परीक्षा ली। सेला
hi.R: जब तुम संकट में थे, तब तुमने मुझे पुकारा, और मैंने तुम्हें बचाया। \q मैंने उस गरजते बादल में से तुम्हें उत्तर दिया जिसमें मैं छिपा था। \q मैंने मरीबा के सोतों के पास तुम्हें परखा। सेला

ru.L: В беде ты взывал, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} избавил тебя; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ответил тебе из укрытия грома; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} испытал тебя у вод Меривы. Села
ru.B: Когда ты был в беде, ты закричал, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} освободил тебя; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ответил тебе из тайного места грома; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} подверг тебя испытанию у вод Меривы. Села
ru.R: Когда ты был в беде, ты позвал {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} спас тебя. \q Я ответил тебе из грозовой тучи, где {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} был скрыт. \q Я испытал тебя у источников Меривы. Села

uk.L: У скруті ти кликав, і я визволив тебе; \q я відповів тобі в схованці грому; \q я випробував тебе при водах Меріви. Села
uk.B: Коли ти був у біді, ти кликав, і я визволив тебе; \q я відповів тобі з потаємного місця грому; \q я випробував тебе при водах Меріви. Села
uk.R: Коли ти був у біді, ти кликав {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, і я врятував тебе. \q Я відповів тобі з грозової хмари, де я був прихований. \q Я випробував тебе біля джерел Меріви. Села

decisions.choice: the hiding place of thunder: Sinai
decisions.reason: God answered from the thick cloud and thunder of Mount Sinai (Exodus 19:16-19; 20:21), hidden from view.

decisions.choice: I tested you at Meribah
decisions.reason: At Meribah ("quarrel") the people tested God by demanding water (Exodus 17:1-7; Numbers 20:13). Here God turns it round: it was he who was testing them (95:8-9).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: tu (God to Israel, addressed in the singular)
decisions.reason: God speaks to Israel as one person here and through verse 17 ("you" singular in the Hebrew), so he says "tu", as in 50:7 and as the Old Testament terms have God address Israel in the singular. Balanced and Readable still say "deles" in verse 7, where the Hebrew "he" is Israel, as the English says "their".

decisions.choice: Meribah as "መሪባ", as Exodus 17:7
decisions.reason: The Exodus form of the name; God's words to Israel use the singular "you" (አንተ), as the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: सेला, kept at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: Selah is a word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a direction for the music. Every level keeps it as a word, set apart at the end of the verse, as the English keeps "Selah", rather than guess at a translation.

decisions.choice: तुम from God to Israel
decisions.reason: God speaks to his people here (verses 7-17). As everywhere in this translation, God speaking to people says तुम, while people praying to God say तू.

decisions.choice: "Села", kept at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: Selah is a word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a musical direction (the meaning decision). As the poetry note settles, every level keeps it as "Села" at the end of its verse, where the English has it, rather than guess at a translation. This holds for every Selah in Psalms 79-89.

source.text: שְׁמַ֣ע עַ֭מִּי וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם־תִּֽשְׁמַֽע־לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear, my people, and I will warn you; Israel, if you would listen to me!

en.L: Hear, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, and I will warn you; \q Israel, if you would listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}!
en.B: Listen, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, and I will give you a solemn warning; \q Israel, oh, that you would listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}!
en.R: Listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people! I am warning you. \q Israel, I wish you would listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}!

fr.L: Écoute, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, et je t’avertirai ; \q Israël, si tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoutais !
fr.B: Écoute, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, et je t’avertirai solennellement ; \q Israël, oh ! si tu voulais {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écouter !
fr.R: Écoute-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple ! Je t’avertis. \q Israël, comme je voudrais que tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoutes !

sw.L: Sikia, Ee watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nami nitakuonya; \q Ee Israeli, laiti ungenisikiliza!
sw.B: Sikilizeni, Ee watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nami nitawapa onyo zito; \q Ee Israeli, laiti ungenisikiliza!
sw.R: Nisikilizeni, watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}! Ninawaonya. \q Israeli, natamani ungenisikiliza!

es.L: Escucha, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, y yo te amonestaré; \q Israel, ¡si {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escucharas!
es.B: Escucha, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, y te daré una advertencia solemne; \q Israel, ¡ojalá {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escucharas!
es.R: ¡Escúchame, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo! Te estoy advirtiendo. \q Israel, ¡cómo quisiera que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escucharas!

vi.L: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hãy nghe, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cảnh cáo con; \q hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, phải chi con chịu nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}!
vi.B: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hãy lắng nghe, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ long trọng cảnh cáo con; \q hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, ước gì con chịu nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}!
vi.R: Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hãy nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! Ta đang cảnh cáo con. \q Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, ước gì con chịu nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}!

ko.L: 들어라, 내 백성아, 내가 너에게 경고하겠다. \q 이스라엘아, 네가 내 말을 듣기만 한다면!
ko.B: 내 백성아, 들어라. 내가 너에게 엄히 경고한다. \q 이스라엘아, 네가 내 말을 들어 주기만 한다면!
ko.R: 내 백성아, 내 말을 들어라! 내가 너에게 경고한다. \q 이스라엘아, 네가 내 말을 들으면 얼마나 좋겠느냐!

pt.L: Ouve, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, e eu te advertirei; \q Israel, se tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escutasses!
pt.B: Escuta, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, e eu te darei uma advertência solene; \q Israel, ah, se tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escutasses!
pt.R: Escuta-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo! Estou te avisando. \q Israel, como eu queria que tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escutasses!

am.L: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፣ ስማ፤ እኔም እመሰክርብሃለሁ፤ \q እስራኤል ሆይ፣ ብትሰማኝ!
am.B: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፣ ስማ፤ ጽኑ ማስጠንቀቂያ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ \q እስራኤል ሆይ፣ ምነው ብትሰማኝ!
am.R: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፣ ስማኝ! አስጠነቅቅሃለሁ። \q እስራኤል ሆይ፣ ምነው ብትሰማኝ!

hi.L: हे मेरी प्रजा, सुनो, और मैं तुम्हें चिताऊँगा; \q हे इस्राएल, काश तुम मेरी सुनते!
hi.B: हे मेरी प्रजा, सुनो, मैं तुम्हें गंभीर चेतावनी देता हूँ; \q हे इस्राएल, काश तुम मेरी सुनते!
hi.R: हे मेरे लोगो, मेरी सुनो! मैं तुम्हें चेतावनी दे रहा हूँ। \q हे इस्राएल, मैं चाहता हूँ कि तुम मेरी सुनो!

ru.L: Слушай, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} предостерегу тебя; \q Израиль, если бы ты послушал {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}!
ru.B: Слушай, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} торжественно предупрежу тебя; \q Израиль, о, если бы ты послушал {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}!
ru.R: Послушай {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ! Я предупреждаю тебя. \q Израиль, как бы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} хотел, чтобы ты послушал {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}!

uk.L: Слухай, {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народе, і я застережу тебе; \q Ізраїлю, якби ти послухав {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}!
uk.B: Слухай, {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народе, і я урочисто застережу тебе; \q Ізраїлю, о, якби ти послухав {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}!
uk.R: Послухай {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народе! Я застерігаю тебе. \q Ізраїлю, як би я хотів, щоб ти слухав {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}!

decisions.choice: Hear, Israel: the words of the covenant
decisions.reason: The call echoes "Hear, Israel" (Deuteronomy 6:4) and God's words in 50:7.

decisions.choice: if you would listen: a longing wish
alternatives: if you listen to me (verse 10 follows)
decisions.reason: The "if" ('im) expresses a wish, as in 95:7: if only Israel would listen. It may also introduce the condition of verse 10.

decisions.choice: warn: testify against, solemnly charge
decisions.reason: The verb ('ud, causative) is the one used in 50:7: God speaks as a witness.

decisions.choice: tú to Israel
decisions.reason: In verses 7-17 God speaks to Israel as one people, and the Hebrew uses the singular "you" (except where it says "their" and "them"). Spanish keeps the singular "tú", so these lines have no plural "you" setting; God's own "me" and "my" take the deity pronoun setting, as in the English.

source.text: לֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה בְ֭ךָ אֵ֣ל זָ֑ר וְלֹ֥א תִ֝שְׁתַּחֲוֶ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל נֵכָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Not there shall be among you a strange god, and not you shall bow down to a god of foreignness.

en.L: There shall not be among you a strange god, \q and you shall not bow down to a foreign god.
en.B: You must have no strange god among you; \q you must not bow down to any foreign god.
en.R: Do not have any other god among you. \q Do not worship a god from another nation.

fr.L: Il n’y aura pas chez toi de dieu étranger, \q et tu ne te prosterneras pas devant un dieu étranger.
fr.B: Tu ne dois avoir chez toi aucun dieu étranger ; \q tu ne dois te prosterner devant aucun dieu d’ailleurs.
fr.R: N’aie aucun autre dieu chez toi. \q N’adore pas un dieu d’un autre peuple.

sw.L: Asiwepo kwako mungu mgeni, \q wala usimsujudie mungu wa kigeni.
sw.B: Usiwe na mungu mgeni kati yako; \q usimsujudie mungu yeyote wa kigeni.
sw.R: Usiwe na mungu mwingine kati yako. \q Usiabudu mungu wa taifa jingine.

es.L: No habrá en medio de ti dios extraño, \q ni te postrarás ante dios extranjero.
es.B: No tendrás ningún dios extraño en medio de ti; \q no te inclinarás ante ningún dios extranjero.
es.R: No tengas a ningún otro dios en medio de ti. \q No adores a un dios de otra nación.

vi.L: Không được có một thần lạ ở giữa con, \q và con không được cúi lạy một thần ngoại bang.
vi.B: Con không được có thần lạ nào ở giữa con; \q con không được cúi lạy bất cứ thần ngoại bang nào.
vi.R: Đừng có một thần nào khác ở giữa con. \q Đừng thờ lạy thần của một dân tộc khác.

ko.L: 너희 가운데 낯선 신이 있어서는 안 되고, \q 너는 이방 신에게 절해서는 안 된다.
ko.B: 너희 가운데 낯선 신을 두지 말고, \q 어떤 이방 신에게도 절하지 마라.
ko.R: 너희 가운데 다른 신을 두지 마라. \q 다른 민족의 신을 섬기지 마라.

pt.L: Não haverá no meio de ti deus estranho, \q e não te prostrarás diante de deus estrangeiro.
pt.B: Não terás no meio de ti nenhum deus estranho; \q não te prostrarás diante de nenhum deus estrangeiro.
pt.R: Não tenhas nenhum outro deus no meio de ti. \q Não adores o deus de outra nação.

am.L: በአንተ ዘንድ እንግዳ አምላክ አይኑር፤ \q ለባዕድ አምላክም አትስገድ።
am.B: በመካከልህ እንግዳ አምላክ አይኑር፤ \q ለማንም ባዕድ አምላክ አትስገድ።
am.R: በመካከልህ ሌላ አምላክ አይኑር። \q የሌላ ሕዝብ አምላክንም አታምልክ።

hi.L: तुम्हारे बीच कोई पराया देवता न होगा, \q और तुम किसी परदेशी देवता को दंडवत न करोगे।
hi.B: तुम्हारे बीच कोई पराया देवता न हो; \q तुम किसी विदेशी देवता के आगे न झुकना।
hi.R: अपने बीच कोई दूसरा देवता न रखना। \q किसी दूसरे देश के देवता की पूजा न करना।

ru.L: Да не будет у тебя чужого бога, \q и не поклоняйся богу иноземному.
ru.B: Пусть у тебя не будет чужого бога; \q не кланяйся никакому иноземному богу.
ru.R: Не держи у себя никакого другого бога. \q Не поклоняйся богу другого народа.

uk.L: Хай не буде в тебе чужого бога, \q і не вклоняйся богові чужинецькому.
uk.B: Не май серед себе чужого бога; \q не вклоняйся жодному чужоземному богові.
uk.R: Не май серед себе жодного іншого бога. \q Не поклоняйся богові іншого народу.

decisions.choice: the first commandment
decisions.reason: The words recall the opening of the Ten Commandments (Exodus 20:3-5; Deuteronomy 5:7-9): no other god, and no bowing down to one.

decisions.choice: strange ... foreign: belonging to other peoples
decisions.reason: Both words (zar, nekhar) describe what is outside Israel and its covenant (44:21).

decisions.choice: future with "tu" (L, B); imperative "Não tenhas", "Não adores" (R)
decisions.reason: The verse echoes the first commandment (m1), so it takes the form the Old Testament terms set for the Law: the future at Literal and Balanced, the imperative at Readable, with God's "tu" at every level.

source.text: אָנֹכִ֨י׀יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ הַֽ֭מַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַרְחֶב־פִּ֝֗יךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: I [am] YHWH your God, who brought you up from [the] land of Egypt; open wide your mouth, and I will fill it.

en.L: I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, \q who brought you up from the land of Egypt; \q open wide your mouth, and I will fill it.
en.B: I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, \q the one who led you up out of Egypt's land. \q Open your mouth as wide as you can, and I will fill it.
en.R: I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. \q I brought you out of Egypt. \q Open your mouth wide. I will fill it with good things.

fr.L: Je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, \q qui t’ai fait monter du pays d’Égypte ; \q ouvre grand ta bouche, et je la remplirai.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, \q celui qui t’a fait monter du pays d’Égypte. \q Ouvre la bouche aussi grand que tu peux, et je la remplirai.
fr.R: Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. \q Je t’ai fait sortir d’Égypte. \q Ouvre grand la bouche. Je la remplirai de bonnes choses.

sw.L: Mimi [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, \q aliyekupandisha kutoka nchi ya Misri; \q panua kinywa chako, nami nitakijaza.
sw.B: Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, \q niliyekupandisha kutoka katika nchi ya Misri. \q Fungua kinywa chako kwa upana kadiri uwezavyo, nami nitakijaza.
sw.R: Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. \q Nilikutoa katika Misri. \q Fungua kinywa chako kwa upana. Nitakijaza vitu vizuri.

es.L: Yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, \q que te hice subir de la tierra de Egipto; \q abre bien tu boca, y yo la llenaré.
es.B: Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, \q el que te sacó de la tierra de Egipto. \q Abre la boca tanto como puedas, y yo la llenaré.
es.R: Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios. \q Yo te saqué de Egipto. \q Abre bien la boca. Yo te la llenaré de cosas buenas.

vi.L: Ta [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của con, \q Đấng đã đem con lên khỏi đất Ai Cập; \q hãy hả miệng con ra, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho đầy.
vi.B: Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của con, \q là Đấng đã dẫn con lên khỏi đất Ai Cập. \q Hãy há miệng con ra thật rộng, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho đầy.
vi.R: Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của con. \q Ta đã đem con ra khỏi Ai Cập. \q Hãy há miệng thật rộng. Ta sẽ làm cho nó đầy những điều tốt lành.

ko.L: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너의 하나님이니, \q 너를 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 올린 이다. \q 네 입을 크게 열어라. 내가 그것을 채우겠다.
ko.B: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너의 하나님이다. \q 너를 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 낸 이가 바로 나다. \q 네 입을 한껏 크게 벌려라. 내가 채워 주겠다.
ko.R: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너의 하나님이다. \q 내가 너를 이집트에서 이끌어 냈다. \q 네 입을 크게 벌려라. 내가 좋은 것으로 채워 주겠다.

pt.L: Eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, \q que te fiz subir da terra do Egito; \q abre bem a tua boca, e eu a encherei.
pt.B: Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, \q aquele que te fez subir da terra do Egito. \q Abre a tua boca o quanto puderes, e eu a encherei.
pt.R: Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus. \q Eu te tirei do Egito. \q Abre bem a tua boca, e eu a encherei de coisas boas.

am.L: እኔ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነኝ]፤ \q ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣሁህ [እኔ ነኝ]፤ \q አፍህን አስፋ፤ እኔም እሞላዋለሁ።
am.B: እኔ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ፤ \q ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣሁህ እኔ ነኝ። \q የቻልከውን ያህል አፍህን አስፋ፤ እኔም እሞላዋለሁ።
am.R: እኔ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ። \q ከግብፅ ያወጣሁህ እኔ ነኝ። \q አፍህን በሰፊው ክፈት፤ በመልካም ነገርም እሞላዋለሁ።

hi.L: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर [हूँ], \q जो तुम्हें मिस्र देश से निकाल लाया; \q अपना मुँह पूरा खोलो, और मैं उसे भर दूँगा।
hi.B: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ, \q वही जो तुम्हें मिस्र देश से निकाल लाया। \q अपना मुँह जितना हो सके उतना खोलो, और मैं उसे भर दूँगा।
hi.R: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ। \q मैं तुम्हें मिस्र से निकाल लाया। \q अपना मुँह पूरा खोलो। मैं उसे अच्छी वस्तुओं से भर दूँगा।

ru.L: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, \q который вывел тебя из земли египетской; \q открой широко свой рот, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наполню его.
ru.B: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, \q тот, кто вывел тебя из египетской земли. \q Открой рот как можно шире, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наполню его.
ru.R: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог. \q Я вывел тебя из Египта. \q Открой рот пошире. Я наполню его добрыми вещами.

uk.L: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, \q який вивів тебе з єгипетської землі; \q відкрий широко свої уста, і я наповню їх.
uk.B: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, \q той, хто вивів тебе з єгипетської землі. \q Відкрий уста якнайширше, і я наповню їх.
uk.R: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог. \q Я вивів тебе з Єгипту. \q Відкрий широко рот. Я наповню його добром.

decisions.choice: I am the LORD your God, who brought you up
decisions.reason: God introduces himself as at the giving of the law (Exodus 20:2). Here the divine name appears in a psalm that otherwise says "God".

decisions.choice: open wide your mouth: ask and expect much
decisions.reason: The picture is of a young bird opening its beak to be fed. God promises to give abundantly; verse 17 shows what he would have given.

decisions.choice: with good things
decisions.reason: Readable says what God would fill it with (m2; verse 17).

decisions.choice: "እኔ አምላክህ [divine name] ነኝ" and "ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣሁህ", as Exodus 20:2 on main
decisions.reason: The line echoes the opening of the Ten Commandments, so it keeps the Amharic of Exodus 20:2 where the Hebrew is close ("brought you up" here, "brought you out" there; Amharic "ያወጣሁህ" covers both).

decisions.choice: मैं प्रभु तुम्हारा परमेश्वर [हूँ], जो तुम्हें मिस्र देश से निकाल लाया
decisions.reason: The line repeats the opening of the Ten Commandments (m1), so it keeps the wording of Exodus 20:2 in this translation at each level.

source.text: וְלֹא־שָׁמַ֣ע עַמִּ֣י לְקוֹלִ֑י וְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹא־אָ֥בָה לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: But not listened my people to my voice, and Israel not was willing toward me.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people did not listen to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} voice, \q and Israel was not willing toward {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people refused to listen to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} voice; \q Israel would have nothing to do with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people did not listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q Israel did not want {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple n’a pas écouté {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} voix, \q et Israël n’a pas voulu de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple a refusé d’écouter {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} voix ; \q Israël n’a rien voulu savoir de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a pas écouté. \q Israël n’a pas voulu de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Lakini watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} hawakuisikiliza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, \q na Israeli hakunitaka.
sw.B: Lakini watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} walikataa kuisikiliza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; \q Israeli hakutaka kuwa na lolote nami.

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo no escuchó {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} voz, \q e Israel no quiso [saber] de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo se negó a escuchar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} voz; \q Israel no quiso tener nada que ver conmigo.
es.R: Pero {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escuchó. \q Israel no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} quiso.

vi.L: Nhưng dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và Y-sơ-ra-ên không chịu thuận theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Nhưng dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không chịu nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q Y-sơ-ra-ên chẳng muốn biết đến {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Nhưng dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Y-sơ-ra-ên không muốn có {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그러나 내 백성은 내 목소리를 듣지 않았고, \q 이스라엘은 나를 원하지 않았다.
ko.B: 그러나 내 백성은 내 목소리를 들으려 하지 않았고, \q 이스라엘은 나를 상대하려 하지 않았다.
ko.R: 그러나 내 백성은 내 말을 듣지 않았다. \q 이스라엘은 나를 원하지 않았다.

pt.L: Mas o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo não escutou a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} voz, \q e Israel não quis [saber] de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.
pt.B: Mas o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo se recusou a ouvir a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} voz; \q Israel não quis nada {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}}.
pt.R: Mas o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escutou. \q Israel não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} quis.

am.L: ሕዝቤ ግን ድምፄን አልሰሙም፤ \q እስራኤልም እኔን አልፈቀደም።
am.B: ሕዝቤ ግን ድምፄን ለመስማት እንቢ አሉ፤ \q እስራኤልም ከእኔ ጋር ምንም ሊኖረው አልወደደም።
am.R: ሕዝቤ ግን አልሰሙኝም። \q እስራኤል እኔን አልፈለገም።

hi.L: पर मेरी प्रजा ने मेरी आवाज़ न सुनी, \q और इस्राएल मेरी ओर इच्छुक न था।
hi.B: पर मेरी प्रजा ने मेरी आवाज़ सुनने से इनकार किया; \q इस्राएल ने मुझसे कोई नाता न रखना चाहा।
hi.R: पर मेरे लोगों ने मेरी न सुनी। \q इस्राएल ने मुझे नहीं चाहा।

ru.L: Но {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ не послушал {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} голоса, \q и Израиль не захотел {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}.
ru.B: Но {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ отказался слушать {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} голос; \q Израиль не желал иметь со {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}} дела.
ru.R: Но {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ не послушал {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. \q Израиль не захотел {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}.

uk.L: Але {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ не слухав {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} голосу, \q і Ізраїль не хотів {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}.
uk.B: Але {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ не захотів слухати {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} голосу; \q Ізраїль не бажав мати зі {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}} нічого спільного.
uk.R: Але {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ не слухав {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}. \q Ізраїль не хотів {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}.

decisions.choice: was not willing: refused
decisions.reason: The verb ('avah) means to consent or be willing. Israel's refusal recalls their unwillingness to enter the land (Deuteronomy 1:26).

records.literal_gloss: And I gave it over to [the] stubbornness of their heart; they walk in their own counsels.

en.L: And I gave them over to the stubbornness of their heart; \q they walked in their own counsels.
en.B: So I left them to their stubborn hearts, \q and they followed their own schemes.
en.R: So I let them do what their stubborn hearts wanted. \q They followed their own plans.

fr.L: Et je les ai livrés à l’endurcissement de leur cœur ; \q ils ont marché selon leurs propres conseils.
fr.B: Alors je les ai laissés à leur cœur obstiné, \q et ils ont suivi leurs propres projets.
fr.R: Alors je les ai laissés faire ce que voulait leur cœur obstiné. \q Ils ont suivi leurs propres plans.

sw.L: Basi nikawaacha kwa ukaidi wa mioyo yao; \q wakaenenda katika mashauri yao wenyewe.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo niliwaacha na mioyo yao mikaidi, \q nao wakafuata mipango yao wenyewe.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo niliwaacha wafanye yale ambayo mioyo yao mikaidi ilitaka. \q Walifuata mipango yao wenyewe.

es.L: Y los entregué a la terquedad de su corazón; \q anduvieron en sus propios consejos.
es.B: Así que los dejé con su corazón terco, \q y siguieron sus propios planes.
es.R: Así que los dejé hacer lo que querían sus corazones tercos. \q Siguieron sus propios planes.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phó họ cho sự cứng cỏi của lòng họ; \q họ đã bước đi theo mưu kế riêng của mình.
vi.B: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để mặc họ với lòng cứng cỏi của mình, \q và họ đi theo những mưu tính riêng.
vi.R: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để họ làm theo điều lòng cứng cỏi của họ muốn. \q Họ đi theo những kế hoạch riêng của mình.

ko.L: 그래서 내가 그들을 그들 마음의 완고함에 내버려 두었으니, \q 그들은 자기들의 계획대로 걸었다.
ko.B: 그래서 나는 그들을 고집스러운 마음대로 내버려 두었고, \q 그들은 자기 꾀를 따라갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 그들이 고집스러운 마음대로 하게 내버려 두었다. \q 그들은 자기들의 계획대로 살았다.

pt.L: E eu os entreguei à teimosia do seu coração; \q eles andaram nos seus próprios conselhos.
pt.B: Por isso eu os deixei entregues aos seus corações teimosos, \q e eles seguiram os seus próprios planos.
pt.R: Então deixei que fizessem o que o seu coração teimoso queria. \q Eles seguiram os seus próprios planos.

am.L: ስለዚህ ለልባቸው እልከኝነት አሳልፌ ሰጠኋቸው፤ \q በገዛ ምክራቸው ሄዱ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ለእልከኛ ልባቸው ተውኋቸው፤ \q የገዛ ዕቅዳቸውንም ተከተሉ።
am.R: ስለዚህ እልከኛ ልባቸው የፈለገውን እንዲያደርጉ ተውኋቸው። \q የገዛ ዕቅዳቸውን ተከተሉ።

hi.L: तब मैंने उन्हें उनके हृदय की हठ के हवाले कर दिया; \q वे अपनी ही युक्तियों पर चले।
hi.B: इसलिए मैंने उन्हें उनके हठीले मन पर छोड़ दिया, \q और वे अपनी ही योजनाओं के पीछे चले।
hi.R: इसलिए मैंने उन्हें वही करने दिया जो उनका हठीला मन चाहता था। \q वे अपनी ही योजनाओं पर चले।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} предал их упрямству их сердца; \q они ходили по своим замыслам.
ru.B: Тогда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} оставил их с их упрямыми сердцами, \q и они следовали своим замыслам.
ru.R: Тогда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} позволил им делать то, чего хотели их упрямые сердца. \q Они жили по своим планам.

uk.L: І я віддав їх упертості їхнього серця; \q вони ходили за своїми власними задумами.
uk.B: Тож я залишив їх з їхніми впертими серцями, \q і вони йшли за своїми власними задумами.
uk.R: Тож я дозволив їм робити те, чого хотіли їхні вперті серця. \q Вони йшли за своїми власними планами.

decisions.choice: I gave them over: judgment by letting go
decisions.reason: God's judgment here is to let his people have what they insist on. Paul describes God's judgment in the same way in Romans 1:24-28.

decisions.choice: stubbornness: a hard, self-willed heart
decisions.reason: The word (sherirut) is used of Israel's stubborn heart in Jeremiah 7:24 and Deuteronomy 29.

source.text: ל֗וּ עַ֭מִּי שֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֑י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל בִּדְרָכַ֥י יְהַלֵּֽכוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: If my people [were] listening to me, Israel in my ways would walk,

en.L: If only {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people were listening to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q [if] Israel would walk in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ways,
en.B: If only {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people were listening to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q if only Israel would walk in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} paths,
en.R: I wish {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people would listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}! \q I wish Israel would live the way I teach!

fr.L: Si seulement {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoutait, \q [si] Israël marchait dans {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} chemins,
fr.B: Si seulement {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoutait, \q si seulement Israël suivait {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sentiers,
fr.R: Comme je voudrais que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écoute ! \q Comme je voudrais qu’Israël vive comme je l’enseigne !

sw.L: Laiti watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wangenisikiliza, \q [laiti] Israeli angeenenda katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}},
sw.B: Laiti watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wangenisikiliza, \q laiti Israeli angetembea katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}},
sw.R: Natamani watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wangenisikiliza! \q Natamani Israeli angeishi jinsi ninavyofundisha!

es.L: Si tan solo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escuchara, \q [si] Israel anduviera en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} caminos,
es.B: Si tan solo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escuchara, \q si tan solo Israel anduviera por {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sendas,
es.R: ¡Cómo quisiera que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escuchara! \q ¡Cómo quisiera que Israel viviera como yo le enseño!

vi.L: Ước gì dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chịu nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q [ước gì] Y-sơ-ra-ên bước đi trong đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
vi.B: Ước gì dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chịu lắng nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q ước gì Y-sơ-ra-ên bước đi trong đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
vi.R: Ước gì dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chịu nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! \q Ước gì Y-sơ-ra-ên sống theo cách {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dạy!

ko.L: 내 백성이 내 말을 듣기만 했더라면, \q 이스라엘이 내 길로 걷기만 했더라면,
ko.B: 내 백성이 내 말을 듣기만 했더라면, \q 이스라엘이 내 길을 따르기만 했더라면,
ko.R: 내 백성이 내 말을 들었으면 얼마나 좋았겠느냐! \q 이스라엘이 내가 가르친 대로 살았으면 얼마나 좋았겠느냐!

pt.L: Se ao menos o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo estivesse {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escutando, \q [se] Israel andasse nos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} caminhos,
pt.B: Se ao menos o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escutasse, \q se ao menos Israel andasse nas {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} trilhas,
pt.R: Como eu queria que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escutasse! \q Como eu queria que Israel vivesse do jeito que eu ensino!

am.L: ምነው ሕዝቤ በሰሙኝ፣ \q እስራኤልም በመንገዴ በሄደ፣
am.B: ምነው ሕዝቤ በሰሙኝ፣ \q ምነው እስራኤል በመንገዶቼ በሄደ፣
am.R: ምነው ሕዝቤ ቢሰሙኝ! \q ምነው እስራኤል እኔ እንደማስተምረው ቢኖር!

hi.L: काश मेरी प्रजा मेरी सुनती, \q [काश] इस्राएल मेरे मार्गों पर चलता,
hi.B: काश मेरी प्रजा मेरी सुनती, \q काश इस्राएल मेरे मार्गों पर चलता,
hi.R: काश मेरे लोग मेरी सुनते! \q काश इस्राएल वैसे जीता जैसे मैं सिखाता हूँ!

ru.L: О, если бы {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ слушал {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, \q [если бы] Израиль ходил {{deity_pronoun:моими|Моими}} путями,
ru.B: Если бы только {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ слушал {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, \q если бы только Израиль ходил {{deity_pronoun:моими|Моими}} дорогами,
ru.R: Как бы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} хотел, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ слушал {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}! \q Как бы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} хотел, чтобы Израиль жил так, как {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} учу!

uk.L: Якби {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ слухав {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, \q [якби] Ізраїль ходив {{deity_pronoun:моїми|Моїми}} дорогами,
uk.B: Якби тільки {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ слухав {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, \q якби тільки Ізраїль ходив {{deity_pronoun:моїми|Моїми}} стежками,
uk.R: Як би я хотів, щоб {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народ слухав {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}! \q Як би я хотів, щоб Ізраїль жив так, як я навчаю!

decisions.choice: if only: a wish that has not come true
decisions.reason: The word (lu) introduces something that is not so but might have been. Verses 15-17 say what would follow.

decisions.choice: walk in my ways: live as God teaches
decisions.reason: The way a person walks is the way he or she lives (1:1; 119:1).

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The result follows in verse 15, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

source.text: כִּ֭מְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֣ם אַכְנִ֑יעַ וְעַ֥ל צָ֝רֵיהֶ֗ם אָשִׁ֥יב יָדִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: in a little their enemies I would subdue, and against their foes I would turn my hand.

en.L: in a little [while] I would subdue their enemies, \q and against their foes I would turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand.
en.B: I would soon bring their enemies low \q and turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against their attackers.
en.R: Then I would quickly defeat their enemies. \q I would use {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} power against the people who fight them.

fr.L: en peu [de temps] j’abaisserais leurs ennemis, \q et contre leurs adversaires je tournerais {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main.
fr.B: bien vite j’humilierais leurs ennemis \q et je tournerais {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre leurs agresseurs.
fr.R: Alors je vaincrais vite leurs ennemis. \q J’utiliserais {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance contre ceux qui les combattent.

sw.L: kwa muda mfupi ningewashinda adui zao, \q na juu ya watesi wao ningegeuza mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.B: ningewashusha adui zao upesi \q na kugeuza mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi ya washambuliaji wao.
sw.R: Ndipo ningewashinda adui zao upesi. \q Ningetumia uweza {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi ya watu wanaopigana nao.

es.L: en poco [tiempo] yo sometería a sus enemigos, \q y contra sus adversarios volvería {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano.
es.B: pronto yo humillaría a sus enemigos \q y volvería {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra sus atacantes.
es.R: Entonces yo derrotaría rápidamente a sus enemigos. \q Usaría {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder contra los que pelean contra ellos.

vi.L: thì trong chốc lát {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ khuất phục kẻ thù của họ, \q và trở tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nghịch cùng những kẻ đối địch họ.
vi.B: Ta sẽ sớm hạ kẻ thù của họ xuống \q và trở tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chống lại những kẻ tấn công họ.
vi.R: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ mau chóng đánh bại kẻ thù của họ. \q Ta sẽ dùng quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chống lại những kẻ đánh họ.

ko.L: 나는 곧 그들의 원수들을 굴복시키고, \q 그들의 대적들에게 내 손을 돌렸을 것이다.
ko.B: 나는 그들의 원수들을 곧 낮추고, \q 그들을 치는 자들에게 내 손을 돌렸을 것이다.
ko.R: 그랬다면 나는 그들의 원수들을 금방 물리쳤을 것이다. \q 그들과 싸우는 자들에게 내 능력을 썼을 것이다.

pt.L: em pouco [tempo] eu subjugaria os seus inimigos, \q e contra os seus adversários voltaria a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão.
pt.B: eu logo humilharia os seus inimigos \q e voltaria a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão contra os que os atacam.
pt.R: Então eu derrotaria depressa os inimigos deles. \q Usaria o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} poder contra os que lutam contra eles.

am.L: በጥቂት [ጊዜ] ጠላቶቻቸውን ባዋረድኩ ነበር፤ \q በባላጋራዎቻቸውም ላይ እጄን በመለስኩ ነበር።
am.B: ጠላቶቻቸውን ፈጥኜ ባዋረድኩ ነበር፤ \q በሚያጠቁአቸውም ላይ እጄን በመለስኩ ነበር።
am.R: ያን ጊዜ ጠላቶቻቸውን ፈጥኜ ድል ባደረግኩ ነበር። \q በሚወጉአቸው ሰዎች ላይ ኃይሌን በተጠቀምኩ ነበር።

hi.L: तो थोड़े ही [समय] में मैं उनके शत्रुओं को दबा देता, \q और उनके बैरियों के विरुद्ध अपना हाथ उठाता।
hi.B: तो मैं जल्द ही उनके शत्रुओं को नीचा दिखाता \q और उन पर हमला करनेवालों के विरुद्ध अपना हाथ उठाता।
hi.R: तब मैं जल्दी से उनके शत्रुओं को हरा देता। \q मैं उनसे लड़नेवालों के विरुद्ध अपनी शक्ति लगाता।

ru.L: вскоре {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} смирил бы их врагов \q и против их противников обратил бы {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку.
ru.B: Я скоро унизил бы их врагов \q и обратил бы свою руку против тех, кто на них нападает.
ru.R: Тогда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} быстро победил бы их врагов. \q Я обратил бы свою силу против тех, кто воюет с ними.

uk.L: незабаром я упокорив би їхніх ворогів \q і проти їхніх супротивників обернув би {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку.
uk.B: я швидко повалив би їхніх ворогів \q і обернув би {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку проти їхніх нападників.
uk.R: Тоді я швидко переміг би їхніх ворогів. \q Я обернув би {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} силу проти тих, хто воює з ними.

decisions.choice: in a little: very soon
decisions.reason: "As a little" means in a short time, quickly (2:12; 94:17).

decisions.choice: turn my hand against: strike
decisions.reason: To turn the hand against someone is to strike them (Isaiah 1:25; Amos 1:8).

source.text: מְשַׂנְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה יְכַֽחֲשׁוּ־ל֑וֹ וִיהִ֖י עִתָּ֣ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [Those who] hate YHWH would cringe to him, and their time would be forever.

en.L: Those who hate {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} would cringe before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and their time would be forever.
en.B: Those who hate {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} would come cringing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and their doom would never end.
en.R: People who hate {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} would bow down to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in fear. \q Their punishment would last forever.

fr.L: Ceux qui haïssent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ramperaient devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q et leur temps serait pour toujours.
fr.B: Ceux qui haïssent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} viendraient ramper devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q et leur sort ne finirait jamais.
fr.R: Ceux qui détestent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se prosterneraient devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec crainte. \q Leur punition durerait toujours.

sw.L: Wanaomchukia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wangejipendekeza kwake, \q na wakati wao ungekuwa wa milele.
sw.B: Wanaomchukia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wangekuja wakitambaa kwake, \q na adhabu yao isingekwisha kamwe.
sw.R: Watu wanaomchukia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wangeinama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa hofu. \q Adhabu yao ingedumu milele.

es.L: Los que aborrecen {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} se encogerían ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q y su tiempo sería para siempre.
es.B: Los que odian {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} vendrían a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} encogidos de miedo, \q y su condena no tendría fin.
es.R: Los que odian {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} se inclinarían ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con miedo. \q Su castigo duraría para siempre.

vi.L: Những kẻ ghét {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ khúm núm trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và thời của chúng sẽ còn mãi mãi.
vi.B: Những kẻ ghét {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ khúm núm đến trước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và sự đoán phạt của chúng sẽ không bao giờ dứt.
vi.R: Những kẻ ghét {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ cúi lạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong sợ hãi. \q Hình phạt của chúng sẽ còn mãi mãi.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 미워하는 자들이 그 앞에 굽실거렸을 것이요, \q 그들의 때는 영원하였을 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 미워하는 자들이 그에게 굽실거리며 나아왔을 것이요, \q 그들의 멸망은 끝나지 않았을 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 미워하는 사람들이 두려워 그에게 엎드렸을 것이다. \q 그들이 받는 벌은 영원히 계속되었을 것이다.

pt.L: Os que odeiam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se encolheriam diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, \q e o tempo deles seria para sempre.
pt.B: Os que odeiam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} viriam rastejando até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, \q e a ruína deles nunca teria fim.
pt.R: Quem odeia {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se curvaria diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} com medo. \q O castigo deles duraria para sempre.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚጠሉ ባጎበደዱለት ነበር፤ \q ዘመናቸውም ለዘላለም በሆነ ነበር።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚጠሉ እየተሽቆጠቆጡ በመጡለት ነበር፤ \q ጥፋታቸውም ለዘላለም ባላበቃ ነበር።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚጠሉ ሰዎች በፍርሃት በሰገዱለት ነበር። \q ቅጣታቸውም ለዘላለም በኖረ ነበር።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से बैर रखनेवाले उनके सामने गिड़गिड़ाते, \q और उनका समय सदा का होता।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से बैर रखनेवाले गिड़गिड़ाते हुए उनके पास आते, \q और उनका विनाश कभी समाप्त न होता।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से बैर रखनेवाले डर के मारे उनके आगे झुकते। \q उनका दंड सदा बना रहता।

ru.L: Ненавидящие {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} пресмыкались бы перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, \q и время их было бы навеки.
ru.B: Те, кто ненавидит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, приползли бы к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} в страхе, \q и их гибели не было бы конца.
ru.R: Люди, которые ненавидят {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, в страхе кланялись бы {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}. \q Их наказание длилось бы вечно.

uk.L: Ті, хто ненавидить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, підлещувалися б перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, \q і їхній час був би навіки.
uk.B: Ті, хто ненавидить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, приповзали б до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}, \q і їхній кінець ніколи б не минав.
uk.R: Люди, які ненавидять {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, у страху вклонялися б {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}. \q Їхня кара тривала б вічно.

decisions.choice: cringe: come crawling in feigned submission
decisions.reason: The verb (kachash) is used of enemies who come crawling to a victor and pretend obedience (18:45; 66:3).

decisions.choice: their time: the doom of those who hate the LORD
alternatives: Israel's time (of blessing) would last forever
decisions.reason: "Their" most naturally means the LORD's enemies, whose time of judgment would not end. It can also refer to Israel, whose time would last forever.

decisions.choice: God speaks of himself by name
decisions.reason: Within his own speech God names himself as "the LORD", as often in the prophets.

decisions.choice: their doom (B); their punishment (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what kind of time is meant (m2).

decisions.choice: God speaks of himself by name in the third person, without the honorific ("그 앞에", "그에게")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has God speak of the LORD as "him" here (meaning decision); Korean keeps the third person, but as the words are God's own he takes no honorific, as the terms notes set for God speaking of himself.

decisions.choice: उनके सामने (honorific)
decisions.reason: God speaks of himself by name here (m3); the pronoun that follows takes the honorific plural that God always has in the third person in this translation, so it is clear that it is the LORD and not the haters who are meant.

source.text: וַֽ֭יַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵ֣לֶב חִטָּ֑ה וּ֝מִצּ֗וּר דְּבַ֣שׁ אַשְׂבִּיעֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he would feed him from [the] fat of [the] wheat, and from [the] rock honey I would satisfy you.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would feed him from the fat of the wheat, \q and with honey from the rock I would satisfy you."
en.B: He would give them the finest wheat to eat, \q and I would fill you up with honey from the rock."
en.R: I would feed you with the best wheat. \q I would give you honey from the rock until you were full."

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le nourrirait de la graisse du froment, \q et du miel du rocher je te rassasierais. »
fr.B: Il leur donnerait à manger le meilleur froment, \q et je te rassasierais du miel du rocher. »
fr.R: Je te nourrirais du meilleur blé. \q Je te donnerais du miel du rocher jusqu’à ce que tu sois rassasié. »

sw.L: Naye angemlisha kwa unono wa ngano, \q na kwa asali kutoka mwambani ningekushibisha."
sw.B: Angewapa ngano iliyo bora kabisa kula, \q nami ningekushibisha kwa asali kutoka mwambani."
sw.R: Ningekulisha ngano iliyo bora kabisa. \q Ningekupa asali kutoka mwambani mpaka ushibe."

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo alimentaría con lo mejor del trigo, \q y con miel de la roca yo te saciaría».
es.B: Él les daría a comer el mejor trigo, \q y yo te saciaría con miel de la roca».
es.R: Yo te alimentaría con el mejor trigo. \q Te daría miel de la roca hasta que quedaras satisfecho».

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nuôi nó bằng phần béo nhất của lúa mì, \q và bằng mật ong từ vầng đá {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho con no nê."
vi.B: Ngài sẽ cho họ ăn lúa mì tốt nhất, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho con no đầy mật ong từ vầng đá."
vi.R: Ta sẽ nuôi con bằng lúa mì tốt nhất. \q Ta sẽ cho con mật ong từ vầng đá cho đến khi con no đủ."

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 그를 기름진 밀로 먹이셨을 것이요, \q 바위에서 나는 꿀로 내가 너를 배불리 먹였을 것이다."
ko.B: 그분께서는 그들에게 가장 좋은 밀을 먹이셨을 것이요, \q 나는 바위에서 나는 꿀로 너를 배불렀을 것이다."
ko.R: 나는 가장 좋은 밀로 너를 먹였을 것이다. \q 바위에서 나는 꿀을 배부르도록 너에게 주었을 것이다."

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o alimentaria com a gordura do trigo, \q e com mel da rocha eu te saciaria."
pt.B: Ele lhes daria do melhor trigo para comer, \q e eu te fartaria com mel da rocha."
pt.R: Eu te alimentaria com o melhor trigo. \q Eu te daria mel da rocha até ficares satisfeito."

am.L: እርሱም ከስንዴው ስብ በመገበው ነበር፤ \q ከዓለቱም በሚወጣ ማር ባጠገብኩህ ነበር።»
am.B: ምርጡን ስንዴ ባበላቸው ነበር፤ \q እኔም ከዓለቱ በሚወጣ ማር ባጠገብኩህ ነበር።»
am.R: ምርጡን ስንዴ ባበላሁህ ነበር። \q እስክትጠግብም ድረስ ከዓለት የሚወጣ ማር በሰጠሁህ ነበር።»

hi.L: और वे उसे गेहूँ की चिकनाई में से खिलाते, \q और चट्टान के मधु से मैं तुम्हें तृप्त करता।"
hi.B: वे उन्हें सबसे अच्छा गेहूँ खिलाते, \q और मैं तुम्हें चट्टान के मधु से तृप्त करता।"
hi.R: मैं तुम्हें सबसे अच्छा गेहूँ खिलाता। \q मैं तुम्हें चट्टान का मधु देता, जब तक तुम्हारा पेट न भर जाता।"

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} кормил бы его туком пшеницы, \q и мёдом из скалы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} насыщал бы тебя.»
ru.B: Он давал бы им есть лучшую пшеницу, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} насыщал бы тебя мёдом из скалы.»
ru.R: Я кормил бы тебя лучшей пшеницей. \q Я давал бы тебе мёд из скалы, пока ты не насытишься.»

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} годував би його найкращою пшеницею, \q а медом зі скелі я наситив би тебе.»
uk.B: Він давав би їм їсти найкращу пшеницю, \q а я насичував би тебе медом зі скелі.»
uk.R: Я годував би тебе найкращою пшеницею. \q Я давав би тобі меду зі скелі, аж поки ти не наситився б.»

decisions.choice: the finest wheat and honey from the rock
decisions.reason: The words recall the song of Moses: God fed Israel with honey from the rock and the finest of the wheat (Deuteronomy 32:13-14). Wild bees nested in clefts of rock.

decisions.choice: he ... him ... I ... you: a change of person
decisions.reason: The line moves from "he would feed him" to "I would satisfy you". God speaks of himself and of Israel first at a distance, then directly. The verbs continue the wish of verse 14: this is what God would have done.

decisions.choice: the fat of the wheat: the very best wheat
decisions.reason: Fat was the best part, and so the best of anything (147:14).

decisions.choice: them
decisions.reason: As in verse 7, Israel is "he" in the Hebrew; Balanced says "them".

decisions.choice: I would feed you
decisions.reason: Readable keeps God and Israel as "I" and "you" through the verse (m2).

decisions.choice: the change of person kept at Literal: "እርሱም ... በመገበው" (he ... him), then "ባጠገብኩህ" (I ... you)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves between persons (meaning decision m2); Literal keeps it, Readable makes it all God's "I", as its English.
